features.name: total_cost_score
features.description: Aggregates buying and maintenance costs into a single dimension, reducing the feature space and improving distance calculations for cost-sensitive neighborhoods.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dimensionality of cost features, creating a smoother gradient for KNN distance metrics.

features.name: capacity_score
features.description: Combines persons and luggage boot capacity, creating a unified utility dimension that helps KNN group vehicles with similar physical space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single axis for physical capacity, improving the geometric grouping of similarly sized vehicles.

features.name: safety_capacity_ratio
features.description: Measures safety relative to passenger capacity, providing a normalized metric that helps identify cars with disproportionate safety features in the KNN space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes safety by capacity, allowing the distance metric to capture relative safety rather than just absolute safety.

features.name: cost_to_utility_ratio
features.description: Evaluates the trade-off between total cost and overall utility (capacity plus safety), creating a continuous gradient for similarity matching.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the value proposition of the vehicle, creating a dense feature space where cars with similar value are closer together.

features.name: high_safety_capacity_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for cars with at least moderate safety and capacity, acting as a cluster indicator to separate viable family cars from others.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a hard boundary in the KNN space, effectively partitioning the neighborhood into high-utility and low-utility clusters.

features.name: distance_to_ideal_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised 'ideal' car prototype (lowest cost, highest capacity and safety), providing a strong radial basis feature for KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms the multi-dimensional space into a 1D distance from an optimal point, simplifying neighborhood structures.

features.name: distance_to_worst_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised 'worst' car prototype (highest cost, lowest capacity and safety), anchoring the opposite end of the feature space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a complementary radial basis feature to the ideal prototype, helping to triangulate positions in the KNN geometry.

features.name: cost_variance
features.description: Absolute difference between buying and maintenance costs, helping KNN distinguish between balanced-cost cars and those with skewed expenses.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a dimension of cost consistency, allowing the model to separate cars with high upfront costs from those with high ongoing costs.

features.name: utility_variance
features.description: Absolute difference between passenger and luggage capacity, identifying specialized vehicles (e.g., cargo vs passenger) in the neighborhood geometry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the distance metric differentiate between balanced utility vehicles and specialized ones, refining local neighborhoods.

features.name: manhattan_distance_to_average
features.description: L1 distance to the dataset's mean feature vector, acting as an anomaly or centrality score that improves density-based neighborhood resolution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures how typical a car is compared to the dataset average, helping KNN adjust for varying point densities.
features.formula: np.abs(buying - 1.475) + np.abs(maint - 1.397) + np.abs(doors - 1.490) + np.abs(persons - 1.035) + np.abs(lug_boot - 0.977) + np.abs(safety - 0.988)

features.name: semantic_family_suitability
features.description: Semantic judgment scoring the car's suitability for a large family based on doors, persons, and luggage capacity, providing a human-aligned similarity dimension.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects domain knowledge into the distance metric, ensuring that cars with similar family-friendly profiles are grouped together.

features.name: semantic_luxury_profile
features.description: Semantic judgment assessing whether the car fits a luxury profile based on cost, maintenance, and safety features, adding a qualitative cluster dimension.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a qualitative axis for similarity, allowing KNN to match cars based on perceived market segment rather than just raw specs.
